reuse.why: Extends the existing isMonthWideCategory predicate that all six month-wide actions already use, and the handler types (typeof actions.*) pick up the new argument automatically.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes in one expression in the shared predicate; each action only forwards the flag, with no copied selection logic.

placement.why: The rule stays in the shared category-selection predicate in server/budget/actions.ts, with the option type defined beside it and the explanatory comment updated.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the six action signatures, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A named MonthWideOptions type and a defaulted option keep old behaviour explicit; forwarding the destructured flag per action is slightly repetitive but trivial.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) go through isMonthWideCategory with the option.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic duplicated; only the flag is forwarded at each call site.
